Founder's Office - Special Projects
Zepto
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (On-site)

About Zepto:
Scaling 10-minute grocery delivery across every major metropolitan area in India.

What you'll do:
• Lead high-urgency operational and strategic problem solving with the founders.
• Scale dark store economics, labor productivity, and vendor management.
• Build financial models and run SQL analyses on delivery turnaround times.

Requirements:
• 1-3 years experience in tier-1 consulting or fast-moving startups.
• Strictly Tier-1 institutes only: IITs or IIMs only.
• High drive, hustle, and on-site commitment in Bangalore.
